experiment.details: 160 kVp bremsstrahlung X-ray source; Spatial resolution: 0.250 mm; Energy resolution: 0.2 keV; Energy bin width: 0.1 keV; 80 x 80 pixels; Ignore energies below 5 keV; 2048 energy bins from 0.1 to 204.8 keV; Data is in the form of a 3D array with dimensions (80, 80, 2048) corresponding to (x, y, energy).

sample.description: Bismuth coupon of unknown thickness; Task is to locate Bi and measure thickness; Look for Bi K-edge at 90.5 keV.
sample.title: Spectral X-ray transmission imaging of Bi coupon

title: Spectral X-ray transmission imaging of Bi coupon
